subject: Recovery signal: onRecovered (D-sensing-007)
body: As you asked: after every detection (drift cue, drift sham, or manual) sensing calls onRecovered({detectionId, t, recoverySeconds, source, censored}) once confidence stays below 0.4 for 2 consecutive windows, or censored=true at 180 s. Recovery is measured on the same peak-to-contrast axis as detection. Sham stays rolled once in the gate, rate configurable to 0 or pinned per trial in a scenario.
